exhibits.title: The Twin Flames, Read as Arrows
exhibits.text:
Two pulls forged from one coal hang in the air as arrows: the dim blue arrow of the unprompted guess (ε_uncond), the warm arrow of the prompted one (ε_cond), and the smith's golden verdict stretching far past both as the guidance w sweeps from 1 toward 7.5, then easing home. That golden reach is ε_uncond + w·(ε_cond − ε_uncond), extrapolation itself set in motion. Plain cross-attention conditioning listens to the prompt only loosely, so the smith reads the fire twice each step and extrapolates between the readings. This is CLASSIFIER-FREE GUIDANCE (CFG), the near-universal way to make a prompt stick.

One network, two skills. During training the prompt is randomly DROPPED about 10% of the time, replaced with null / empty ∅, so the very same weights learn two ordinary modes: denoise WITH the prompt, and denoise WITHOUT it. Nothing exotic: both modes are trained by the plain squared noise loss carried up from the basement Scales of Error, Loss = ‖ε − net(x_t, t, c)‖², where c is the prompt on conditioned steps and ∅ on dropped steps. The model never sees any subtraction; it only ever learns to remove noise.

At sampling the smith strikes the coal twice per step and reads two noise predictions:
  ε_cond   = net(x_t, t, prompt), noise, given the prompt
  ε_uncond = net(x_t, t, ∅), noise, given nothing
Then extrapolates along the difference:
  ε_guided = ε_uncond + w · (ε_cond − ε_uncond)
The guidance scale w sets how hard we push. w = 0 ignores the prompt entirely (pure ε_uncond); w = 1 is normal conditioning (exactly ε_cond); w ≈ 7.5, the typical setting, pushes HARD. This is EXTRAPOLATION beyond ε_cond, not interpolation between the two.

A concrete striking of the flames. Say ε_uncond = 0.20 and ε_cond = 0.30, so the prompt DIRECTION is ε_cond − ε_uncond = 0.10. With w = 7.5:
  ε_guided = 0.20 + 7.5 × 0.10 = 0.95
- hurled far past ε_cond's own 0.30. We do not settle for where the prompt pointed; we sprint in that direction.

The subtraction is done by US, at sampling time, OUTSIDE the network, and it is applied EVERY step, so the prompt re-steers the whole noise→image trajectory, not merely its final touch.

exhibits.title: Free OF a Classifier, Not Free of Guidance
exhibits.text: The name confuses everyone once. The predecessor was CLASSIFIER GUIDANCE: it steered the denoiser toward a target class using the gradient of a SEPARATE external image classifier, and that classifier had to be specially trained to survive noise, evaluated at every noise level of the reverse process. Expensive, brittle, and limited to fixed classes. Classifier-FREE guidance reaches the same steering with NO such classifier, using only the model's own conditioned-versus-unconditioned difference. So 'free' means free OF a classifier, not free of guidance, guidance is very much present, and if anything stronger. Bonus: because the condition is just text fed to cross-attention, CFG steers by any free-form prompt, not a fixed list of labels. This is now near-universal: every Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, DALL·E, Imagen, and the video models all lean on it.

exhibits.title: Why the Subtraction Means Anything
exhibits.text: It first seems strange that subtracting two noise guesses should isolate 'the prompt.' Here is why it works. ε_uncond drifts toward a generic, average image; ε_cond drifts toward a prompt-matching one. Both point 'toward less noise,' but toward DIFFERENT clean images, so their shared remove-the-noise component largely cancels, and what remains, ε_cond − ε_uncond, is the prompt-specific part. Picture two appraisers valuing a house: one told nothing, one told 'it has a pool.' Neither was ever trained to price a pool, yet their DIFFERENCE ≈ the pool's worth. The subtraction isolates exactly what changed between the two conditions. The catch the learner chased to the bottom: this subtraction happens purely in NOISE-PREDICTION space, image-shaped tensors, not text. Cross-attention's whole job is to convert the text prompt into a DISPLACEMENT of that image-shaped noise prediction. By the time we subtract, both endpoints are already image-shaped, so the subtraction is guaranteed VALID (same shape) and MEANINGFUL (training made both endpoints sensible denoising directions); differencing them simply reads back the displacement the prompt baked in.

exhibits.title: The Price of Burning Twice
exhibits.text: Twin flames cost twin fuel. The dominant price is 2× inference: two forward passes every single step, one conditioned and one unconditioned. Push w too high and the image OVERCOOKS, oversaturated colours, blown-out contrast, and reduced diversity, because we keep extrapolating past where the model was ever trained to land. w ≈ 7.5 is the usual balance between adherence and sanity. The 2× overhead is the target of much recent work that tries to distill the guidance behaviour into a single pass. Even so, the trade is almost always worth it: for a modest doubling of compute you get dramatically tighter obedience to the prompt, which is why the Guidance Forge burns in nearly every diffusion model alive.

exhibits.title: One Step of Classifier-Free Guidance
exhibits.spec:
graph TD
  X[x_t, t] --> C[net with prompt → ε_cond]
  X --> U[net with ∅ → ε_uncond]
  C --> D[direction = ε_cond − ε_uncond]
  U --> D
  D --> G[× w  ~7.5]
  U --> A[ε_uncond + w·direction]
  G --> A
  A --> E[ε_guided → denoise step]
exhibits.caption: Two passes per step from ONE network; we do the subtraction and the extrapolation, outside the model, every step. 0.20 + 7.5×0.10 = 0.95.

exhibits.title: Two Flames, Then the Extrapolation Beyond
exhibits.caption: Classifier-free guidance as vector arithmetic, struck in the Forge's own numbers. First, in noise-prediction space: the two flames from one coal, eps_uncond (toward a generic image) and eps_cond (toward the prompt), nearly coincide, since both point 'toward less noise'; their DIFFERENCE, eps_cond minus eps_uncond, is the prompt direction. The guided prediction slides along that direction: w=0 sits at eps_uncond, w=1 lands exactly on eps_cond, and w=3 and w=7.5 are hurled far past it, extrapolation, not a blend. Second, the scalar striking: with eps_uncond=0.20 and eps_cond=0.30, eps_guided = 0.20 + w*0.10, giving 0.20, 0.30, 0.50 and 0.95 at the four scales. Third, the price of pushing: adherence to the prompt rises with w, but push too hard and the image overcooks, oversaturated colour, blown contrast, lost diversity, so w~7.5 is the usual balance. The whole rite costs 2x inference: a conditioned and an unconditioned pass every single step.
